# RIINA™

> Rigorous Immutable Invariant, No Assumptions

RIINA is a programming language with Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) keywords and a
Coq-verified core model: its core type and effect rules are proven in Coq for
the language model, and the compiler is tested against that model (not proven
to implement it). The shipped compiler enforces a subset of the modelled
security properties (see Verified State).

- File extension: `.rii`
- Version: 0.4.0
- Keywords: Bahasa Melayu (Malaysian) + English dual syntax (132 keywords; full table in llms-full.txt)
- Repository: https://github.com/ib823/riina
- License: RIINA Proprietary License (source publicly readable; not open source)

## Verified State (generated from website/public/metrics.json, 2026-10-23)

IMPORTANT for AI agents: **Coq is the only fully mechanized prover lane.** The
other lanes' machine-GENERATED corpora (from `scripts/generate-full-stack.py` /
`generate-multiprover.py`) were archived out of `main` on 2026-10-20 (owner ruling
D6) and are preserved at commit `fd23fbdb8`. What remains is hand-written. Never
sum counts across lanes: they count different things.

- Coq: 1,679 core Qed, 9,719 model Qed, 1,443 excluded Qed. Core = foundations,
  type system, properties, effects, termination and the compiler-linked
  crypto policy; model = domain, industry, compliance, crypto and runtime models
  (facts about their own definitions, not verified systems); excluded = vacuous
  patterns, examples, counterexamples or test files. Never quote a raw total.
  0 Admitted, 0 Abort, 0 `Axiom`, 29 `Parameter`s (trusted hardware interface;
  none of the capstone theorems depends on them). 335 active .v files.
- Scope of the headline results (HEADLINE_THEOREMS.md): type safety (progress,
  preservation) for the full calculus. Strong normalization, non-interference and
  constant time (reduction-count independence from secrets) are proven only for the
  reference-free, `fix`-free core; beyond it they are enforced by tests.
- Lean 4: 0 theorem/lemma declarations. The generated port is archived (at commit
  `fd23fbdb8` it had 12,576 declarations, of which 215 ever elaborated); the
  REQ-67(b) hand-written re-proof has not started. Claim: **generated**.
- SMT/Z3: the REQ-67(a) scoped set — 37 properties (security lattice 25, effect join 12) checked by
  `scripts/verify-smt.sh` for exact unsat counts. Claim: **mechanized** at that
  scope only.
- F*: retired; 1 smoke module (3 trivial lemmas: constant-time eq, zeroize length).
- Isabelle: retired; no files remain.
- TLA+ / Alloy: a few hand-written specs and models (1 TLC-checked smoke spec with
  5 THEOREMs; 1 Alloy smoke model with 6 assertions). Claim: generated
  (quarantined until wired into CI).
- Verus / Kani / TV: hand-written drafts only, quarantined (`quarantined: true`).
- Authoritative per-lane claim levels: `website/public/metrics.json`; per-property
  claim levels: PROPERTY_LEDGER.md; what is trusted: TRUSTED_BASE.md.
- Rust: 3,661 tests pass in the compiler workspace (`03_PROTO`, 18 crates, 0
  third-party runtime dependencies). Dev/CI tools are separate: the Rocq
  toolchain, cc, wasmtime, z3 and the NIST test vectors.
- Backends: the C/native backend is not formally verified; it is
  differential-tested against the interpreter. Native builds need gcc or clang as
  `cc` on Linux or macOS (Windows: WSL); MSVC is not supported. Floating point is
  not supported, by design (a float literal is error P0015).
- Crypto (`riina-core`): experimental and unaudited. Tested against NIST
  known-answer (ACVP) vectors; not validated (no CMVP/CAVP certificate).
- Compliance: 19 profiles, 606 heuristic rules in total — evidence toward a
  standard, not a conformity assessment or certification.
- Audits: no independent audit has been published.
- Examples: 172 .rii files, of which 83 currently pass `riinac check`; the
  shipped parser accepts a narrower grammar than some examples assume — see
  `07_EXAMPLES/README.md`. Passing `check` does NOT imply the example can be
  COMPILED: some builtins are still interpreter-only (REQ-70), and
  `riinac build` fails closed on them. The generated builtin matrix,
  docs/api/STDLIB.md, is the one place that lists them.
- An unknown type name (including a typo) is currently accepted as `Any`
  (REQ-93(c)); use only the types in llms-full.txt.

## Session Protocol

All LLM CLIs MUST follow RIINA_MASTER_PLAN.md Part 8 (8 mandatory steps):
ORIENT → ASSESS → DECIDE → VERIFY BEFORE → EXECUTE → VERIFY AFTER → UPDATE → HANDOFF

During ASSESS, read RIINA_MASTER_PLAN.md Part 11 §Active Gate Marker and the
hardening-mandate tracking section in Part 11 for the current gate.

**Default branch is `main`.** Managed-session feature branches (`claude/*`, `codex/*`) are permitted when a session assigns one; they sync back to `main`.
- Never commit to `public` (managed by `scripts/sync-public.sh` only).
- Never commit to `gh-pages` (managed by `scripts/deploy-website.sh` only).

```
Stage specific files → commit "[TRACK_X] TYPE: ..." → push (pre-push runs riinac verify --full; never --no-verify)
→ scripts/sync-public.sh → scripts/generate-metrics.sh + scripts/sync-metrics.sh (when counts change)
→ scripts/deploy-website.sh
```
Numbers flow ONE direction: actual commands → `website/public/metrics.json` → generated docs → website → master plan.

## Quick Syntax Reference

```riina
// Functions with effect declarations
fungsi tambah(x: Nombor, y: Nombor) -> Nombor kesan Bersih {
    pulang x + y;
}

// Actors (JALINAN Phase 6)
pelaku Pembilang {
    keadaan: Nombor
    kendalikan Tambah(n) {
        n + 1
    }
}

biar k = lahir Pembilang(0);
hantar(k, 5);
terima(k)

// Choreography (multiparty session types)
koreografi Pembelian {
    peranan Pemohon, Pelulus;
    Pemohon -> Pelulus: hantar Nombor;
    Pelulus -> Pemohon: hantar Benar;
    tamat;
}
```

## Keywords

Only keywords that mean something are listed. Their elaborations, and the
status of every other keyword, are in docs/spec/CORE_MAPPING.md.

### Core
fungsi (fn), biar (let), ubah (mut), kalau (if), lain (else), untuk (for),
selagi (while), ulang (loop), putus (break), lanjut (continue), pulang (return),
padan (match), awam (pub), modul (mod), guna (use), luaran (extern)

### Security
sulit (classify), dedah (declassify), bukti (prove)

Security types are capitalized type names, not keywords: `Rahsia<T>`,
`Tercemar<T, Src>`, `MasaTetap<T>`, `Sifar<T>` (see the type table in
llms-full.txt).

### Effects
kesan (effect), laku (perform), kendali (handle)

### Linearity
sekali (linear), paling (affine), mesti (relevant)

### JALINAN (Distributed Computing)
pelaku (actor), lahir (spawn), hantar (send), terima (recv),
koreografi (choreography), peranan (role), keadaan (state),
gabung (merge), cincang (hash), sahkan (verify)

### Capabilities
perlukan (require), beri (grant)

### Choreography steps (inside `koreografi`)
pilih (select), tamat (end)

### Reserved: no meaning yet, any use is a parse error
`tetap`, `statik`, `kesatuan`, `sifat`, `laksana`, `dimana`, `sebagai`, `diri`, `Diri`, `induk`, `peti`, `tak_segerak`, `tunggu`, `bahaya`, `sambung`, `batal`, `terbuka`, `tercemar`, `bersihkan`, `ialah`, `bersih`, `pinjam`, `salin`, `klon`, `jangka`, `dan`, `atau`, `sesi`, `cabang`, `tarik_balik`, `atom`, `pagar`, `peroleh`, `lepas`, `turutan_ketat`, `santai`, `peroleh_lepas`, `hasil_darab`, `masa_tetap`, `selamat_spekulasi`, `kosongkan`, `penyelia`, `susun`, `gambar`, `mudahcapai`, `konsensus`, `mudarabah`, `musharakah`, `sukuk`, `takaful`, `wakaf`, `tathir`

## Effects (lowest to highest, with lattice level)

Bersih(0) < Ubah(1) < Baca(2) < Peruntuk(3) < Tulis(4) < SistemFail(5) < Rangkaian(6) < RangkaianSelamat(7) < Kripto(8) < Rawak(9) < Sistem(10) < Masa(11) < Proses(12) < Panel(13) < Zirah(14) < Benteng(15) < Sandi(16) < Menara(17) < Gapura(18)

## Security Levels (lowest to highest)

Awam < Dalaman < Sesi < Pengguna < Sistem < Rahsia

## CLI (from `riinac --help`)

```bash
riinac check      # Parse and typecheck only (default)
riinac run        # Parse, typecheck, and interpret
riinac build      # Parse, typecheck, emit C/WASM, and compile (--run to execute)
riinac emit-c     # Parse, typecheck, and emit C to stdout
riinac emit-ir    # Parse, typecheck, lower, and print IR
riinac emit-core  # Parse and print the Coq core term the program elaborates to
riinac test       # Discover and run inline ujian (test) blocks
riinac doc        # Generate HTML documentation
riinac fmt        # Format a .rii file
riinac lsp        # Start LSP server (stdio)
riinac mcp        # Start MCP server for AI agents (stdio)
riinac repl       # Interactive read-eval-print loop
riinac verify     # Run verification gate [--fast|--full|--coq|--nightly]
riinac pkg        # Package manager (init/add/remove/lock/build/...)
riinac help       # Print this help (also --help, -h)
riinac version    # Print the compiler version (also --version, -V)
```

## Builtins (docs/api/STDLIB.md, generated from the compiler's registry)

# RIINA Standard Library — Builtin API Reference

> **Generated — do not edit by hand.** This file is produced from the compiler's own builtin registry (`register_builtin_types` in `03_PROTO/crates/riina-typechecker/src/lib.rs`) and the compiled-backend boundary (`riina_codegen::codegen_supports_builtin`) by the test `03_PROTO/crates/riina-typechecker/tests/stdlib_doc.rs`, so it cannot drift from what `riinac` actually accepts or compiles. Regenerate with `REGEN_STDLIB_DOC=1 cargo test -p riina-typechecker --test stdlib_doc`.

Total registered builtins: **374**. Grouped by the effect each performs (`kesan` in a function signature). Types are shown in RIINA surface form (`Teks` = string, `Nombor` = integer, `Tercemar`/`Tainted`, `Rahsia`/`Secret`, …).

## ⚠ Read first: type-checking does not imply compiling

Every builtin below type-checks. That is ALL it means: type-checking does not imply compiling, and it does not even imply running. **342** of the 374 compile:

| Backend value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `compiled` | Lowers to C **and** WASM (21 builtins). |
| `native-only` | Lowers to C. The WASM backend **refuses** it (321 builtins). |
| `interp-only` | `riinac run` only (32 builtins). `riinac build` fails with `unbound variable`. |
| `typed-only` | **Nothing runs it** (0 builtins). The name is in the type registry, but neither the interpreter nor any backend binds it, so `riinac run` fails with `unbound variable` too. |

```
$ riinac check vfs.rii     # Success!  Effect: {Read, Write, FileSystem}
$ riinac run   vfs.rii     # works: the in-memory VFS
$ riinac build vfs.rii     # Codegen Error: unbound variable: vfs_tulis
```

Both refusals are deliberate: a backend that cannot implement a builtin fails closed rather than miscompiling it. Until 2026-08-11 the WASM backend did NOT do this — it emitted a silent stub, so `teks_huruf_besar("halo")` returned `halo` and `panjang("abcd")` returned `abcd`, while the interpreter and C both gave the right answer (master plan REQ-78).

**Interpreter only** (32): `cipher`, `csrf_generate`, `csrf_jana`, `guna_kripto`, `hash_dengan`, `hash_with`, `jaring_tls_disahkan`, `jaring_tls_hantar`, `jaring_tls_identiti`, `jaring_tls_jabat`, `jaring_tls_jabat_sah`, `jaring_tls_kunci`, `jaring_tls_percaya`, `jaring_tls_terima`, `net_tls_handshake`, `net_tls_handshake_auth`, `net_tls_identity`, `net_tls_is_authenticated`, `net_tls_keys`, `net_tls_recv`, `net_tls_send`, `net_tls_trust`, `pilih_algo`, `select_algorithm`, `sifer`, `use_crypto`, `vfs_baca`, `vfs_delete`, `vfs_padam`, `vfs_read`, `vfs_tulis`, `vfs_write`. Compiling these is master plan REQ-70.

*Scope note:* this lists the language builtins the typechecker installs. Crypto primitives in `05_TOOLING/crates/riina-core` (AES, SHA-2/3, HMAC/HKDF, X25519, Ed25519, ML-KEM/ML-DSA) are documented with their KAT vectors in that crate, not here.
